data.standardized_narrative: For the 2016 financial year, Syndicate 1729 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 0.822 million, primarily attributable to the 2014 underwriting year. This represents a 3.07% strengthening relative to the opening gross claims outstanding. The report notes a net surplus of GBP 0.7 million on prior year reserves, driven by better than expected claims experience in casualty and property reinsurance, indicating a divergence between gross and net movements.
raw_causal_phrases: This has been primarily generated by better than expected claims experience on casualty reinsurance and property reinsurance classes of business.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development of +GBP 0.822m (strengthening) is calculated from the gross claims incurred development table for the 2014 underwriting year. This contrasts with the narrative on page 16 which states 'an overall surplus of GBP 0.7m on prior year reserves' (a net release), indicating a significant impact of reinsurance on the net position. The causal phrases provided in the report relate to this net release, not the gross strengthening.
